meta.name: Donington Park
meta.description: Donington Park, Grand Prix (4.02 km) and National (3.19 km) circuits from OpenStreetMap, with heights, camber and terrain from the Environment Agency LIDAR Composite DTM (1 m). Rolling Leicestershire parkland with the drop through the Craner Curves and the Melbourne Loop.

imported.source: Layout and woodland (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0. Heights: Environment Agency LIDAR Composite DTM 1 m, (c) Environment Agency copyright and/or database right 2022, Open Government Licence v3.0. Widths: Contains Environment Agency information (c) Environment Agency and/or database right, Open Government Licence v3.0. Run-off, barriers and trees: measured from Environment Agency LIDAR point clouds (OGL v3.0) and OpenStreetMap (ODbL), barrier types from published track guides (tools/real_tracks_data/runoff_evidence.json).

kerbs.source: driver61.com Donington guide: Redgate's inside kerb is very flat and every car can run over it
driver61.com Donington guide: the kerb through the Craner Curves can be used a little
driver61.com Donington guide: running beyond the blue-and-white exit kerb isn't allowed; a thin strip of concrete then grass beyond it
driver61.com Donington guide: the whole left-hand kerb of Schwantz Curve is flat and can be run over
driver61.com Donington guide: flat inside kerb; the whole blue-and-white exit kerb can be used, with a strip of green concrete outside it
driver61.com Donington guide: Coppice's kerb is flat and can be run over
driver61.com Donington guide: a large raised 'sausage' kerb on the inside of Goddards (the game's kerbs are 5 cm, so it is a plain apex kerb here)
